title: SKE Bar Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod
description: Made for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit, this Cherry Ice pod delivers a rich, fruity inhale followed by a cooling menthol exhale. The sweet, slightly tart Cherry flavour is bold and juicy, lifted by an icy finish that makes for a clean and refreshing vape. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt and features mesh coil technology for a consistent, flavourful MTL vape. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
